mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, resource, scope_type, scope_ref_id, expires_at FROM sys_data_scope WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND resource = #{resource} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_data_scope (tenant_id, user_id, resource, scope_type, scope_ref_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{resource}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeRefId})
